title: Product completion after 957-file full audit
businessRules: The post-audit workflow docs/TOKO360-MASTER-PRODUCT-COMPLETION-WORKFLOW.md is authoritative for new product-completion work; historical R0-R8 recovery remains evidence only.
No capability can close from route/button/source-marker existence alone.
Every visible contextual navigation item must map to semantically isolated operator content.
Critical/high functional work requires runtime mutation evidence; UI completion additionally requires human visual acceptance.
Foundation/baseline/adapter-ready capabilities must not be presented as production-complete.
Human Stage-20 cannot be replaced by automated browser tests.
Ubuntu Bash is the canonical operator/developer command surface.
Atomic-wave commit/push/clean/sync rules remain mandatory.
Tax-affecting fixes must preserve effective-dated/versioned tax semantics and historical period correctness; no retroactive mutation of used tax versions.

P1 source isolation must preserve the canonical contextual route map (62/62 after splitting Customer from Category/Subcategory); P1 cannot close until browser route-heading evidence, screenshots, and human IA acceptance pass.
Browser UAT critical Admin journeys must resolve through config/admin-contextual-workflow-map.json and stable Admin workspace/view semantics; legacy hard-coded workspace ownership is forbidden.

P2A transaction UOM authority is ProductUnit at order/sale creation; persisted transaction snapshots are immutable historical authority for fulfillment, return and refund, so current ProductUnit changes must never reinterpret old transactions.

OrderItem.quantity and return-item quantity remain canonical integer base-unit quantities for inventory/batch/serial movements; unitQuantity and quantityFactor preserve operator/customer transaction UOM.
Prisma schema-only validate/generate commands must be provider-safe without rewriting the active .env; database-touching commands must still require a real provider-matching protected DATABASE_URL.
P2 is one atomic delivery wave; P2A/P2B are internal implementation streams and must not create separate operator apply/test/commit boundaries.

P2 runtime closure requires both dedicated exact-source PostgreSQL gates: ci:p2a:multi-uom-probe for A-03 and ci:p2:payroll-probe for A-04; migration/source tests or unrelated recovery probes cannot promote either finding to RUNTIME_VERIFIED.

Payroll tax methods GROSS, GROSS_UP and NET are executable supported configuration; valid effective-dated component/profile/rule changes are segmented by actual active dates and must not return REQUIRES_REVIEW solely because they occur inside one payroll period.
Split-period tax/social allocation must use actual temporal component amounts with exact remainder handling; proportional stretching of one period total across statutory segments is forbidden.

Exact-runtime probes must self-provision deterministic fixtures for the capability under test; they must not depend on mutable demo seed/catalog stock or artifacts left by earlier probes. Any direct fixture mutation must be locked to the exact expected non-production PostgreSQL host/database before writing.

Exact-source identity in a Git worktree must hash Git-tracked authored source files only; runtime-created untracked/generated files must not change the source fingerprint, while any content change to a tracked source file must still change it.

Tenant/branch-scoped NumberSequence must emit a user-facing number containing authoritative branch scope (or company scope when branchless) whenever persisted transaction number columns are globally unique; identical local sequence values across tenants must never collide.

P2 FULL is runtime-verified only on exact-source commit 899685ce23c08c8a0246867afc0c78a36507e674 / fingerprint 36af0df55489492e4389f7bf0a511bbaa60cae761937b77edcd310003cdfa04d; P2 business source is frozen absent regression evidence.
P3 is one atomic delivery wave covering A-05, A-06, A-08 and A-11 together; do not create operator commit/apply boundaries per subfeature.

Daily summary ownership is ADMIN_EXPLICIT in P3: materialization is an intentional Admin Data Governance operation; worker automatic ownership must not be claimed unless a later phase explicitly changes the contract.
Feature enabled state and product maturity are separate truths; scoped feature overrides must preserve catalog maturityClass, operatorVisibility, ownership and helpText.
Archive execution requires explicit ARCHIVE confirmation and retains status/error/checksum/artifact URI/provider history; P3 runtime verification must prove this on non-production exact source.
P3 exact-runtime closure requires ci:p3:probe PASS in both exact-source GitHub workflows and aggregate evidence on the same source fingerprint with productionTouched=false.

P3 FULL is runtime-verified on exact-source commit c61273e99104c0dbdc61ee4790379d4ed2edd8a3 / fingerprint cfe0323c096eb253730c1751e37ecc3a0b4e77853d3048360271ed97e360f8c5; P3 is frozen without regression evidence.
P4 is one atomic wave: verified-unused /sale-returns* and /purchase-returns* aliases are removed, /returns/* remains authoritative, and nine-domain ownership truth is machine-readable.
P4 exact-runtime closure requires ci:p4:probe PASS in both heavy GitHub workflows and aggregate evidence with productionTouched=false.

Post-completion POST-1 is planned only after P7 + Human Stage-20 + current PRODUCT_READY: each store/branch gets a local-first TOKO360 server, central hosting consolidates through event/transaction sync, mobile/PWA and Telegram use canonical APIs, and LAN price kiosks are read-only; POST-1 must not interrupt P4-P7.

P4 FULL is runtime-verified on exact-source commit d305ade2050765de86c7f5ef1c54eb7426c5e25b / fingerprint cf6165fcc74e94abb3866230aa1764cee9487d4de6b630377465d20bda7d9246; P4 source is frozen absent regression evidence.
P5 is one atomic visual-product wave across Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal; global CSS-only or marker-only closure is forbidden.

P5 automated closure requires audit:p5:visual and exact-source ci:p5:probe screenshot evidence for 14 Admin primary workspaces, 13 Admin contextual routes, 4 POS views, 5 Storefront views and 7 Employee Portal views at desktop/tablet/mobile geometry.
P5 automated PASS cannot set human visual acceptance; human review remains an explicit separate gate.

P5 Browser UAT must not depend on demo seed data: both heavy GitHub workflows explicitly enable a non-production storefront fixture; Browser UAT creates one active product through canonical POST /products only when the public branch catalog is empty, records productionTouched=false, and still requires the real catalog-to-product-detail screenshot journey.
P5 V1 exact-source automation is green on af7cb87bbdc1ee898f785a072993e79877326b27 but human runtime video review rejected the flat/stacked/mostly-black visual result.
P5 V2 is a single presentation-only atomic wave across Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal; P6 remains blocked until V2 automated evidence and explicit human acceptance both pass.
P5 V2 keeps decorative gradients forbidden while requiring product-specific color identity, glass/backdrop blur, elevation/shadow, and reduced navigation stacking.
P5 V2 automated exact-source evidence is green on fd2d29d9a8d7d6bd0db3c1e085fb4e376440f6bc but the second human visual review rejected the presentation; automation does not override that rejection.
P5 V3 is one total Tailwind UI rebuild wave, not a sequence of CSS micro-patches; accumulated prior-generation presentation overrides are forbidden.
P5 V3 freezes all business/API/security/tenant/domain semantics while replacing presentation across Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal.
P5 V3 product shells must be utility-first Tailwind v4 and globals.css must be a bounded @theme/@apply compatibility layer only.
acceptanceCriteria: P0-P7 are executed in order without skipping dependency gates.
All A-01 through A-15 audit findings are either closed with evidence or explicitly reclassified with documented rationale.
14 Admin primary workspaces and all retained contextual views render semantically correct isolated workflows.
Master Data exposes Category/Subcategory and Customer as separate operator destinations; Category supports obvious add-root/add-subcategory hierarchy actions.
Multi-UOM order/return/refund lineage is persisted and runtime-verified.
Payroll supported methods and split-period behavior are implemented and runtime-verified or removed from product claims.
Retention/archive, API-key rotation, and session lifecycle have intentional operator ownership.
Admin, POS, Storefront, and Employee Portal pass human visual acceptance after page-level redesign.
Final exact-source runtime simulation and Human Stage-20 both pass before PRODUCT_READY=true.
P3 A-05/A-06/A-08/A-11 ship as one wave with Admin operator ownership, maturity truth, and exact-runtime evidence.
P3 exact-runtime probe proves session revoke denial, API-key rotation/revoke, archive safety/history/checksum/artifact, Admin daily summary materialization, audit events and feature maturity truth.
P4 removes legacy return aliases only after compatibility/consumer verification and proves canonical /returns/* remains live.
P4 canonical ownership audit covers inventory, returns, accounting, payments, notifications, payroll, assets, marketplace and summaries.

A canonical post-completion roadmap exists for hybrid central-host + per-branch local servers, deterministic offline/online sync, mobile/PWA + Telegram stock operations, and LAN barcode price kiosks, while remaining explicitly non-blocking for P0-P7 PRODUCT_READY.
P5 provides product-specific page composition for Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal with intentional hierarchy, responsive density and explicit state surfaces.
P5 exact-source Browser UAT produces the configured page-level screenshot matrix and 1440/1024/390 geometry evidence.
P5 human visual acceptance remains mandatory and separate from automated exact-source PASS.

P5 Browser UAT remains deterministic with bootstrap seed: an empty public catalog is prepared through an explicit non-production canonical product fixture, never by enabling demo seed or skipping the product-detail screenshot.
Admin uses deep-indigo layered enterprise surfaces with compact sidebar hierarchy and one contextual navigation layer.
POS uses teal touch-first operational surfaces with high-contrast sale/cart/shift/returns/sync hierarchy.
Storefront is a light premium retail surface and no longer visually resembles the dark back-office products.
Employee Portal is a light violet self-service surface with personal rather than Admin visual identity.

Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal render as four deliberate professional products with clear hierarchy/alignment, responsive geometry and modern cards/forms/tables/charts while preserving all functional contracts.
P5 V3 source audit and all dependency-free regression tests pass before local packaging.
Exact-source GitHub Browser/P5/R7/R8/aggregate gates pass on the V3 commit and human visual acceptance is then explicitly recorded before P6.
P5 V3.3 exact-source Browser UAT records ADMIN_SHELL_GEOMETRY PASS with sidebar in the left desktop column, main consuming the remaining width, and mobile main consuming full width.
P5 V4 total presentation rebuild must replace the rejected V3 visual generation across Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal without changing business/API/permission authority.
P5 V4 Browser UAT must prove four computed runtime visual identities and Admin semantic geometry on the exact same source fingerprint before Human Visual Acceptance.
P5 V4 POS root must be a bright touch-first retail cockpit at runtime; legacy dark root presentation is a regression.

P5 V4 local quality gate typechecks Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal without consuming `.next/dev/types` or mode-switching next-env.d.ts, so an active/stale Next dev session cannot corrupt CI/local verification.

npm run lint -w @toko360/api
npm run lint -w @toko360/admin
npm run workflow:validate
npm run validate:repo

npm run test:dependency-free
Exact-source PostgreSQL/runtime/browser evidence for every CRITICAL/HIGH wave
Human Stage-20 visual and functional acceptance
Runtime inventory invariant: stock quantity/available/reserved and append-only movement remain consistent across transaction/reversal flows
Runtime accounting invariant: journal entries remain balanced debit=credit and reversal/posting traces remain canonical
Runtime sync invariant: idempotency, retry, offline replay, and conflict handling remain fail-closed where affected
Browser contextual-route contract audit must pass before exact-source Browser UAT and must reject stale capability ownership.

P2A exact-source PostgreSQL runtime: create mixed-UOM storefront order, fulfill it, mutate/deactivate current ProductUnit, then return/refund and prove persisted UOM snapshot, inventory base quantity, tax and accounting reversal remain consistent.

P2A exact-source gate must produce handoff/quality/github-p2a-multi-uom-runtime-probe-latest.json with PASS, matching source fingerprint, productionTouched=false, historical UOM after ProductUnit deactivation, balanced fulfillment/return journals, exact amount remainder, and base-inventory round-trip.

P2A fixture isolation regression: the mixed-UOM runtime probe must create its own untracked/batch-free/serial-free product inventory fixture with >=8 base units, must not scan for pre-existing >=4 stock, and must fail closed unless DATABASE_URL matches the expected CI/UAT non-production host/database.
Exact-source fingerprint regression: in a Git worktree, adding an untracked runtime artifact under apps/ must not change the fingerprint, while modifying a tracked authored file must change it.

Document-number tenant-scope regression: two tenant-local sequences may both start at 000001, but generated business numbers must remain globally distinct and branch scope must be validated against company.
node --test tests/product-completion-p3-hidden-capability-productization.test.mjs

Both full-system-simulation and toko360-full-uat must report P3 productization probe success before P3 can become RUNTIME_VERIFIED.

node --test tests/product-completion-p4-canonical-ownership.test.mjs

Both heavy GitHub workflows must report P5 visual rebuild probe success before P5 automated closure.

P5 finance responsive regression: Admin Keuangan Chart of Accounts create form must not use a fixed four-column grid at 1440px; source contract requires accountCreateGrid to collapse before the 96rem wide-layout breakpoint.

P5 Storefront fixture regression: both heavy workflows set T360_UAT_PREPARE_P5_STOREFRONT_FIXTURE=true; Browser UAT reads the public PUSAT catalog, creates an active product via authenticated POST /products only when empty, waits for public visibility, records P5_STOREFRONT_PRODUCT_FIXTURE productionTouched=false, then must open and screenshot the real product detail view.
Exact-source Browser screenshots for P5 V2 at 1440/1024/390, followed by explicit human visual review.
npm run audit:p5:visual must run the original P5 screenshot contract plus scripts/audit-p5-v3-tailwind-rebuild.mjs.
P5 V3 focused regression: F12R2, UI-P1, F12R4, UI-P7, POS/Storefront/Employee UI contracts and product-completion-p5 tests.
Exact-source ci:p5:probe must record visualGeneration=P5-V3, businessApiAuthorityFrozen=true, productionTouched=false and humanAcceptance=PENDING.
Human V3 runtime review must inspect Admin/POS/Storefront/Employee on desktop/tablet/mobile before P6.
P5 V3 Tailwind build regression: Storefront compatibility CSS must not use @apply group or group-hover variants; parent hover behavior must use a valid selector and production build must pass.

P5 V3.2 POS mobile runtime regression: exact-source Browser UAT at 390x844 must keep scrollWidth <= viewport+3 after the topbar stacks below sm and warehouse/actions become shrink/wrap-safe; do not weaken Browser/R7/P5 geometry thresholds.
migrationPlan: Use expand-only migrations for new persistence required by functional-completeness fixes. Rehearse PostgreSQL migrations before exact-runtime closure. Never rewrite applied migration history.
rollbackPlan: Rollback one atomic wave at a time to the preceding clean exact-source checkpoint. Schema-changing waves require a documented compatibility/roll-forward strategy; do not use destructive migration rollback against shared data.
monitoringPlan: Each wave records source fingerprint, runtime probe evidence, browser evidence where UI changes, audit status, and human acceptance status. Final product status is rendered from one canonical capability truth source.
securityNotes: Remove tracked credentials immediately, preserve tenant/branch/permission authority, keep runtime probes non-production, sanitize evidence, and never weaken denial/fail-closed gates to obtain green.
verificationGates: P2 Payroll exact-source PostgreSQL runtime: execute GROSS, GROSS_UP and NET in one effective-dated payroll period, prove actual split component/rule allocation, balanced posting, salary settlement, post-payment differential adjustment, employee-receivable recovery and recovery settlement.

P2 full aggregate gate requires both handoff/quality/github-p2a-multi-uom-runtime-probe-latest.json and handoff/quality/github-p2-payroll-runtime-probe-latest.json PASS on matching source fingerprints with productionTouched=false.
P3 exact-source runtime gate covers A-05 retention/archive, A-06 API-key/session lifecycle, A-08 capability maturity truth, and A-11 explicit Admin daily-summary ownership as one atomic wave.
P3 aggregate gate requires handoff/quality/github-p3-productization-probe-latest.json PASS on current source and productionTouched=false.
P4 exact-source runtime gate proves legacy return aliases are absent from Swagger/router while canonical /returns/* routes remain live.
P4 aggregate gate requires github-p4-canonical-ownership-probe-latest.json PASS on the current source fingerprint with productionTouched=false.
P5 exact-source visual gate requires page-level screenshot coverage for all configured Admin/POS/Storefront/Employee surfaces and desktop/tablet/mobile responsive matrices.
P5 automated evidence remains distinct from mandatory human visual acceptance.

P5 exact-source Browser gate must pass with bootstrap seed while preserving a real Storefront product-detail screenshot; any fixture used for this proof must be explicit non-production setup through canonical API and productionTouched=false.
P5 V2 must preserve all prior P5 Browser geometry and screenshot coverage while changing only presentation.
Human visual acceptance after V2 is mandatory before P6.
P5 V3 total UI source gate must reject P5 V2 override selectors and prove utility-first Tailwind shells plus four distinct product identities.
P5 V3 exact-source Browser/P5/R7/R8/aggregate chain must remain green without weakening business/security/runtime gates.
Human visual acceptance after V3 is mandatory before P6.
P5 V3.2 exact-source Browser gate must close the POS 390x844 overflow seen on V3.1 commit 17539ad56114432ee940ab640612f7983294515f before R7/P5/R8-release/aggregate can be considered green.
P5 V4 source gate requires p5-v4 generation markers, four distinct product identities, Tailwind-first shells, controlled gradient/depth rules, and frozen business/API/permission authority.

P5 V4 exact-source Browser gate requires P5_V4_ADMIN_VISUAL_IDENTITY, P5_V4_POS_VISUAL_IDENTITY, P5_V4_STOREFRONT_VISUAL_IDENTITY and P5_V4_EMPLOYEE_VISUAL_IDENTITY PASS in addition to the screenshot/responsive matrix.
Human visual acceptance after V4 is mandatory before P6.

P5 V4.4 Next build isolation regression: no Next production build may consume .next/dev/types; active next dev must fail the build gate explicitly, stale .next/dev must be removed before next build, and production .next/types/routes.d.ts must exist afterward.

P5 V4.5 deterministic Next gate: all four Next products must use phase-selected TypeScript configuration: development uses canonical tsconfig.json, while production typegen/build uses tsconfig.build.json that extends canonical compilerOptions, includes only .next/types, explicitly excludes .next/dev, and never enables ignoreBuildErrors. Verification must reject a live next dev writer, rebuild generated .next from zero, require production .next/types/routes.d.ts, and reject any production next-env.d.ts reference to .next/dev/types.

P5 V4.6 Admin reference-dashboard source gate requires exactly six KPI cards, six named dashboard panels (sales-performance, top-revenue-drivers, product-performance, recent-activity, stock-watchlist, quick-actions), line+donut chart identity, and complete shared semantic Admin CSS primitives.

P5 V4.6 Browser gate requires the Admin default sidebar/root to be light, persisted dark-mode toggle to switch root+sidebar dark and restore light, ADMIN_REFERENCE_DASHBOARD PASS, ADMIN_THEME_LIGHT_DARK PASS, and all prior responsive/geometry/screenshot evidence.

P5 V4.7 full-root source gate requires audit:ui:domain-depth PASS across Admin/POS/Storefront/Employee: required semantic CSS authority present, POS light-first, tenant/branch context visible across all four products, all seven Employee views reachable on mobile, canonical POS digital receipt exposed, no direct no-op/permanent-disabled controls, and no unexpected API-only controller.

P5 backend/UI exposure gate permits only F9 as the explicitly partial capability because live external notification-provider readiness is not source-completable; F10 source is implemented and remains IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING until exact-source runtime/browser evidence. edge-sync remains the sole intentional API-only controller.
P5 V4.7 operator boundary is one cumulative fail-closed artifact followed by real four-Next production builds and explicit Human Visual Acceptance; per-surface patch delivery is forbidden.

P5 V4.8.2 React runtime integrity gate: no React hook may be registered after a loading render guard in audited frontend components; ExtensionsView must use one canonical extension snapshot loader including the loyalty customer directory, and focused regression must reproduce the hook-order boundary statically.

P5 V4.8.2 dev freshness gate: all four Next workspace dev commands must route through scripts/run-next-dev-workspace.mjs, validate exact Next version, delete isolated .next/dev before startup, and force T360_NEXT_VERIFY=0 so stale presentation assets cannot masquerade as current source.

P5 V4.9 root-design gate: Admin, POS, Storefront and Employee Portal must use the shared persisted `toko360:ui-theme` protocol, deterministic light default, pre-hydration bootstrap, explicit light/dark toggle and complete dark-surface ownership while preserving V4.8.2 runtime-integrity and fresh-dev contracts.

P5 V4.10 theme-integrity gate: Admin/POS/Storefront/Employee must use unique product-scoped theme storage keys, deterministic light default, safe next/script beforeInteractive bootstrap, and no raw <script> element inside React layouts.

P5 V4.10 cross-product isolation gate: changing Storefront/Admin theme must not alter POS/Employee persisted theme state; login-only surfaces must retain real light/dark controls and Storefront dark mode must remain neutral with emerald accents rather than a full-green skin.
constraints: P5 V3.3 Admin layout regression: outer shell must not own desktop CSS grid when auxiliary nodes are direct children; dedicated adminLayout owns the 272px+main columns and Browser UAT must verify sidebar/main geometry at 1440/1024/390, not overflow alone.

P5 V4 supersedes the rejected V3 no-gradient presentation rule; controlled brand/depth gradients are allowed, but business meaning may not depend on decorative effects and automated visual identity must remain fail-closed.

P5 V4.6 supersedes the prior dark-Admin-sidebar visual contract after explicit human rejection; the default Admin reference is light with a persisted user-selectable dark mode. This changes presentation only and must not modify business/API/permission/domain behavior.

P5 V4.7 root wave must not invent UI for backend capability that does not exist or classify provider/device-only integration as operator-ready; presentation/exposure changes may only bind existing canonical routes and trusted tenant context.

P5 V4.8.2 runtime screenshot evidence supersedes static-green claims when React hook invariants or stale Next dev output make the operator runtime diverge from authored source; source gates must fail closed on both classes before another Human Visual Acceptance attempt.

P5 V4.9 is presentation-only: shell/layout changes must not introduce API, Prisma, inventory, accounting, tax, payment, payroll, tenant-authority or permission-authority imports/logic; real four-Next build plus explicit Human Visual Acceptance remain mandatory before commit/push or P6.

P5 V4.10 supersedes the V4.9 shared-theme-key decision: theme persistence is product-scoped to prevent cross-product visual leakage; this remains presentation-only and cannot change business/API/permission logic.
decisions: P5 V4.5 generated-type authority follows official Next configuration boundaries: development uses tsconfig.json, and non-development Next phases use tsconfig.build.json selected from next.config.mjs by phase. Corrected 2026-09-29: isolatedDevBuild is no longer carried — Next.js removed the key, so it only emitted an unrecognized-config warning while isolating nothing; the isolation is carried by tsconfig.build.json excluding the dev tree.

P5 V4.5 keeps one compiler-options authority: tsconfig.build.json MUST extend ./tsconfig.json and MUST NOT override compilerOptions; it only narrows generated type inputs to production .next/types and excludes .next/dev. ignoreBuildErrors remains forbidden.

Pre-GitHub 2026-10-03 source hardening requires retriable order/finance create mutations to fail closed without a stable operation key; Storefront/POS must preserve the same key for same-payload retry, and payroll component/assignment reads must be cursor-paginated with bounded branch-safe lookup.
notes: P5 V4.5.1: T360_NEXT_VERIFY forces production tsconfig for deterministic Next typegen/build while dev keeps canonical tsconfig; real server production build still mandatory before artifact release.

P5 V4.6 human visual regression: prior V4 automated gates were false-green because structural composition and shared semantic CSS coverage were not enforced. V4.6 closes both gaps before another operator visual review.

P5 V4.7 deep audit: 36 API controllers / 451 handlers; F2/F3/F4/F5/F6/F7/F8/F11 EXPOSED, F9/F10 PARTIAL by documented backend readiness, edge-sync intentionally API-only. Semantic presentation authority is now fail-closed across all four UIs.

P5 V4.9 staging verification on 2026-09-28: focused root-design/runtime 55/55 PASS; dependency-free 1030/1030 PASS; workflow/repository/product/Admin/canonical/P5/UI/full-repository audits PASS. Ubuntu operator is the final visual runtime authority because container Chromium simulation was abandoned after two environment-level timeouts.

P5 V4.10 runtime evidence: Employee raw-script console error and POS/Storefront cross-theme leakage were root architectural defects in V4.9. Root repair uses product-scoped keys plus Next Script bootstrap. Server evidence: focused 66/66 PASS, dependency-free 1035/1035 PASS, all source/audit gates PASS; Ubuntu real build + Human Visual Acceptance pending.

Pre-GitHub 2026-10-03 reconciliation: idempotency and payroll-pagination source gaps are closed; F10 is source-implemented / IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_PENDING with deterministic permission-scoped assistant and explainable forecast/reorder, while F9 remains PARTIAL pending live external provider readiness.
